law: Use the XCUIAutomation framework to control your app’s user interface and inspect its state.
Use to write tests that control your app using XCUIAutomation, and check if your app’s state matches your expectations.
You can still use it to test compatible iPad and iPhone apps that you build using the iOS SDK but run in visionOS.
Replicate sequences of interactions and make sure that your app’s user interface behaves as intended.
